'''Popal Howrider''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who may have lived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. He was the cousin of [[Ettal Howrider]], who was said to be one of the six "beautiful women" on Agamar before being shot by Popal.

==Behind the scenes==
There is some uncertainty as to whether Howrider is an actual person or simply a figment of [[Garik Loran]]'s imagination.
